name: OS Client Certs -- decrypt & re-encrypt S/MIME forward
description: When forwarding an S/MIME encrypted message, automatically decrypt the original, replace the raw smime.p7m blob with the decrypted content and attachments, and re-enable S/MIME encryption for the new recipients. Requires identity with S/MIME signing/encryption certificates. v0.3.17 (TEST): captures Thunderbird's non-bubbling compose-window-init event so ComposeBodyReady is observed reliably, with a shorter compatibility fallback timeout.
